text:
Mira Chen: FYI postmortem concluded that the KV eviction cascade + model variant fallback timing caused the user-facing latency spike. I want to convert the postmortem items into concrete tests and owners. Can we list what needs to land in the next 2 weeks?

Ravi Patel: +1. Suggested items: prompt-set that reproduces the failure mode (long prefix -> eviction), a small load test to exercise continuous batching, and a nightly regression that replays the agent requests we saw. I put a draft promptset here: https://internal/redwood/evals/promptsets/kv-eviction-2025.md

Sam Ortiz: For prioritization, recommend: 1) nightly regression (catch flakiness), 2) promptset for semantic regression, 3) small-scale chaos drill for eviction policy. Nightly regression should aim to reproduce within 30min of run.

Jordan Lee: I can own the chaos drill run. Plan: 1) create a k8s job that artificially reduces available GPU memory for 10-30s and observe model fallbacks; 2) verify rollout fallback and alerting. Proposed date: 2025-01-10 cadence: one-time drill then quarterly. I'll add a playbook snippet:```bash
# run locally against staging
kubectl apply -f tools/chaos/gpu-evict-job.yaml
# wait for 60s then restore
```

Kate Nguyen: From SRE side, we should add a targeted load test that reproduces the token-rate burst pattern we saw. I propose a small harness in `tests/load/eviction_burst.py` scheduled nightly in CI for the next 3 weeks. Tuning targets: p50 latency under 120ms, no evictions > 10% request rate.

Mira Chen: Ownership check: Ravi -> promptset + eval harness (PR expected by EOW). Kate -> nightly load/regression CI (setup by Tue). Jordan -> chaos drill + playbook (run 2025-01-10). Sam -> triage and rollout policy review (lead meeting Friday). ops-bot, please create a follow-up card in the incident board and schedule a 30m sync.

ops-bot: Created card #INC-4122 "kv-eviction: regression + chaos plan" assigned to Mira Chen, due 2025-01-17. Meeting scheduled: 2025-01-03 10:00 UTC.

Ravi Patel: Quick notes for implementation: promptset should include short/long prefix pairs and edge-case tokens; add expectation checks for model variant selection. Example test command: `pytest tests/evals/test_kv_eviction.py -k short_prefix --maxfail=1`. I'll open PR later today: https://github.com/redwood/repro/pull/678

Sam Ortiz: Also add a post-run alert to the nightly job that posts to #eng-oncall if regression fails 2 nights in a row. We had silent failures before because notifications were scoped to infra only.

Kate Nguyen: I'll add dashboards: per-run pass/fail, eviction_rate, fallback_count, latency_p50/p95. Dashboards linked in the card.

Mira Chen: Timeline recap: EOW PRs for promptset + eval harness, Tue for CI nightly + dashboard, 2025-01-10 chaos run. Owners confirmed. If anyone can't meet deadlines shout here or DM.

Jordan Lee: small follow-up: during the chaos run let's enable verbose kv logs: `KV_LOG_LEVEL=debug` and capture traces to s3: `s3://redwood-test/kvs/eviction-drill/210501`.

Ravi Patel: noted. I'll add a short repro script to the PR so CI can run locally.

Kate Nguyen: tagging @sam-ortiz for the alert config, will need oncall rotation name.

Sam Ortiz: I'll own alert config.

Mira Chen: Thanks all. Will mark INC-4122 as in-progress and we will run a short status update on Friday's infra sync. :thumbsup:
